snippet.title: Mega Man: The Rulers of Space [GAMEPLAY REVEAL]
snippet.description:
A fan-made 16-bit SUPER remake of the GameBoy "Mega Man V" (aka Rockman World 5)!

Follow the official game page here!
https://gamejolt.com/games/MegaManTheRulersOfSpace/871547

A team effort with the talents of:
Programming & Game Design: MarcDWyz (me lol)
Pixel Art: Tim (from the streams) & @egoraptor 
Music:  @MaxieDaMan 
Concept & promo Art: https://twitter.com/koy_campbell

#MegaManRS #MegaMan #Rockman #ロックマン #mmvweek
